raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner committed scope drift by redefining “where Robert Khayat was educated” to mean the University of Mississippi School of Law instead of the University of Mississippi as a whole. This led to proposing Cleve McDowell (law school, 1963) rather than the correct university-wide first Black student, James Howard Meredith (1962).
